ideas.idea: Add a canonical to Blog (and Docs) using metadataBase, e.g. alternates canonical '/docs'
ideas.why: Docs has no canonical (known), but Blog is also missing one and metadataBase is set; the Blog half is accurate and concrete.

ideas.idea: Make Blog an async server component, give each post its own page and sitemap entry
ideas.why: Fixes the client-only rendering and gives posts crawlable URLs, specific to this repo.

ideas.idea: Blog fetches /api/posts but no app/api route exists in the repo, so add the route
ideas.why: Accurate: no app/api folder is in the files, so the Blog may render nothing.

ideas.idea: Add Organization and WebSite JSON-LD in the layout
ideas.why: The site has no structured data, and the name and URL could be stated for machines; it's concrete, though the benefit is modest.

ideas.idea: Flesh out Docs page beyond a single sentence with setup steps as text
ideas.why: Docs has one sentence, so real setup content helps readers and machines understand the product.

ideas.idea: List paid plans and prices as text on Pricing
ideas.why: The description promises plans for every team size but only the free tier appears.

ideas.idea: Give page titles more context, such as 'Ledger Docs: set up your account'
ideas.why: Titles 'Docs' and 'Pricing' do not name the brand, and the layout has no title template.

ideas.idea: Add <lastmod> to sitemap entries, possibly via app/sitemap.ts
ideas.why: Accurate, but it applies to almost any site and has little effect on a four-URL sitemap.

ideas.idea: Link from the home page body to Docs and Pricing
ideas.why: The nav already links to all four pages on every page, so an in-body link adds little.

ideas.idea: Remove Pricing from the sitemap if the noindex is deliberate (alternative to fixing the noindex)
ideas.why: It restates the known Pricing noindex/sitemap contradiction as an alternative resolution.
